children: Unity Bancorp named its president George Boyan as its next chief executive officer.
Boyan would succeed James Hughes, who plans to retire from the CEO role on March 31, 2027, after more than two decades with Unity, the bank holding company said.
Hughes will continue to be a member of the boards of both Unity Bancorp and its subsidiary Unity Bank following his retirement, the company said.
Boyan's appointment is set to take effect April 1, 2027. He will continue to hold his position as president of Unity Bancorp and Unity Bank, a role he has held since January, the company said.
